results.title: Bombshell Letter Revealed in Jared and Ivanka’s Resort Saga
results.description: JNI/Star Max / GC Images A letter written by villagers from an Albanian peninsula where Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner plan to build a luxury resort has undermined their assertion that they were unaware of claims the land was stolen. Nearly two years ago, villagers in Zvërnec wrote a letter to Jared Kushner’s firm pleading with the president’s son-in-law not to develop a $1.4 billion resort on the allegedly stolen land. The villagers informed the firm that they were involved in decades-long court disputes over the property, which was allegedly stolen by Artur Shehu, a suspected gangster accused of forging Ottoman-era land records, The Wall Street Journal reported. The site, the villagers alleged, is “owned by the village and its residents.” Read more at The Daily Beast.

results.title: Drone helps Baton Rouge officers capture man following stolen car pursuit
results.description: BATON ROUGE — A drone helped officers with the Baton Rouge Police Department arrest a man following a stolen vehicle pursuit early Sunday morning. According to the department, around 3 a.m., officers attempted to make a felony stop on a recently stolen vehicle when the driver refused to stop, leading to a pursuit. The suspect, identified as Korey James, allegedly bailed from the vehicle before fleeing on foot into a wooded area near Nellie Avenue at Elgin Street. A drone operated by a K9 Unit quickly found James' heat signature in an open field, allowing officers to arrest James without further incident. James has a criminal history that includes arrests for first-degree murder, unauthorized use of a motor vehicle and aggravated assault. Permalink | Comments
